title: Boy Swallows Universe
description: Two brothers navigate a brutal childhood filled with family problems, addiction, violence, and strange possibilities. A surprisingly emotional story about good, evil, family, and the choices people make.

title: The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar
description: A ridiculously charming and visually distinctive Wes Anderson story about a wealthy man who discovers a way to see without using his eyes.

title: Lovesick
description: A funny and surprisingly thoughtful romantic comedy that uses its relationships to explore expectations around dating, marriage, careers, family, and gender.

title: Messiah
description: A mysterious man claims to be a divine figure while intelligence agencies and ordinary people struggle to determine who he really is.

title: Search Party
description: A darkly funny mystery about a group of friends whose lives spiral into increasingly bizarre and dangerous situations.

title: The Man in the High Castle
description: A fascinating alternate-history premise where the Axis powers won World War II. The early mystery and setting were excellent, but later episodes became increasingly frustrating.
